reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the worst-case range rule and the missing-amount case.

duplication.why: No rule logic is copied; the API model just calls the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts, where the tree maps internal schedules to API shapes, with the handler type updated in types/api-handlers.ts.

scope.why: Model field, return type, focused tests and a release note per repo convention; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Simple and tied to the shared rule; the separate APIScheduleListEntity type is reasonable though toExternal now always returns the list shape for every caller.
